name: super-board
description: Autonomous GitHub Project board runner. Primary skills: super-board, super-build, super-qa, super-review, super-collect. Secondary skills: visual, git-sync, ui-refine-loop. Installed as a plugin it ships the skills only; run /super-board onboard to add the guard hooks, .claude/bin scripts and workflows (get.sh / install.sh install all of it in one go).
